scope: Main-paper review: seven PCA imaging components, lesion-volume correlation, discourse-task differences and fluent/non-fluent group contrast. Table 1, Table 2, Figure 4 and numerical Results visually checked. Supplements excluded.

Executive cluster appears only after lesion-volume adjustment.
White-matter anatomy is descriptive atlas overlap, not patient tractography or measured disconnection.
Age, education and time since stroke are adjustment variables, not demonstrated independent predictors; sex is descriptive.
Same or overlapping cohort with Alyahya2018 papers, Butler2014 and Halai2017; no independent replication claim.
Visual PDF confirms <= signs in discourse results that text extraction renders as >; subgroup interaction df=188 is printed despite n=46, retained as unresolved.
remaining: Named-person approval; reconcile shared-cohort evidence before synthesis.
